findings.F1: The book is short on 58% of bars (long 34%, flat 8%, mean position −0.007), so it gives up the coins' rise. Its mean daily return is 0.000105 against 0.00118 for holding, its Sharpe is 0.50 against 0.55, and its Calmar is 0.27, from a 3.6% yearly return over a 13.5% deepest fall.
findings.F2: The short side earns nothing. Short bars (n=10120) have a mean gain of −0.000003 because the coin's next-day return there is only −0.0002. Long bars (n=6018) carry all of the book's gain, at 0.00057 per bar on a next-day coin return of 0.0034.
findings.F3: Forecast quintiles 0–3 all show a negative 3-day excess return (−0.0024, −0.0028, −0.0026, −0.0009) and only the top quintile is positive (+0.0087, n=1145). The pooled slope of t=4.1 (n=5723) comes from heavy days alone, while light volume carries no graded fall to short.
findings.F4: Heavy volume pays only on days the coin closed lower. On down days the top volume-ratio quintile (mean ratio 2.25) has a 3-day excess return of +0.0242 (t=4.5, n=397), and quintiles 0–3 sit between −0.001 and −0.005 with |t|<1.4. On up days the top quintile has −0.0033 (t=−0.8, n=460).
findings.F5: The heavy-volume down-day gain is positive in 7 of 8 years, at +0.016 to +0.061, with t up to 3.9 in 2020. It is positive whatever the 30-day trend: +0.022 (t=3.5, n=206) when the 30-day return is negative and +0.026 (t=3.0, n=191) when it is positive.
findings.F6: Heavy volume on an up day while the coin's 30-day return is negative is followed by a 3-day excess return of −0.024 (t=−3.9, n=166). The same heavy-volume long that the tested idea buys loses in this situation.
findings.F7: The gain is not linear in the product of the down move and the volume ratio (slope t=0.27, n=4283), but it is graded at the extreme quintile (+0.0070, t=2.1). The effect sits in the heaviest-volume falling days, not across all days.

ideas.idea: The heavier a coin's day volume relative to its own 30-day average volume, the higher its return over the next 3 days, only on days when the coin closed lower than the day before.
ideas.consequence: A heavy-volume down day is a reason to favour a long over the next few days, more firmly the heavier the volume, while a heavy-volume up day gives no such reason.
ideas.name: heavy volume selling exhaustion

ideas.idea: The heavier a coin's day volume relative to its own 30-day average volume on a day it closed higher, the lower its return over the next 3 days, only while its 30-day return is negative.
ideas.consequence: A heavy-volume rally inside a falling month is a reason to refuse a long, or to lean short, over the next few days, more firmly the heavier the volume.
ideas.name: heavy-volume rally in downtrend fades
